cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Galarian Yamask
cards.description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

cards.name: Galarian Runerigus
cards.description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.description: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

cards.name: Barbaracle
cards.description: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

cards.name: Galarian Weezing
cards.description: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

cards.name: Morgrem
cards.description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl
cards.description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.description: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

cards.name: Applin
cards.description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Applin
cards.description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Appletun
cards.description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka
cards.description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda
cards.description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.description: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola
cards.description: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola
cards.description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Hattrem
cards.description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

cards.name: Hatterene
cards.description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
cards.description: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
cards.description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
